namespace io {
  const int SIZE = (1 << 21) + 1;
  char ibuf[SIZE], *iS, *iT, obuf[SIZE], *oS = obuf, *oT = oS + SIZE - 1;
  inline char getc () {return (iS == iT ? (iT = (iS = ibuf) + fread (ibuf, 1, SIZE, stdin), (iS == iT ? EOF : *iS ++)) : *iS ++);}
  inline void flush () {fwrite (obuf, 1, oS - obuf, stdout); oS = obuf;}
  inline void putc (char x) {*oS ++ = x; if (oS == oT) flush ();}
  template<class T>
  inline void read(T &x) {
    char ch; int f = 1;
    x = 0;
    while(isspace(ch = getc()));
    if(ch == '-') ch = getc(), f = -1;
    do x = x * 10 + ch - '0'; while(isdigit(ch = getc()));
    x *= f;
  }
  template<class T, class ...Args>
  inline void read(T &x, Args&... args) {read(x); read(args...);}
  template<class T>
  inline void write(T x) {

    if(x < 0) putc('-'), x = -x;
    while(x) stk[top++] = x % 10, x /= 10;
    while(top) putc(stk[--top] + '0');
  }
  template<class T, class ...Args>
  inline void write(T x, Args... args) {write(x); putc(' '); write(args...);}
  inline void space() {putc(' ');}
  inline void endl() {putc('\n');}
  struct _flush {~_flush() {flush();}} __flush;
};
using io::read; using io::write; using io::flush; using io::space; using io::endl; using io::getc; using io::putc;

int M;
inline int add(int x, int y) { return x + y >= M ? x + y - M : x + y; }
template <class... Args> inline int add(int x, int y, Args... args) { return add(add(x, y), args...); }
inline int sub(int x, int y) { return x - y < 0 ? x - y + M : x - y; }
inline int mul(int x, int y) { return 1LL * x * y % M; }
template <class... Args> inline int mul(int x, int y, Args... args) { return mul(mul(x, y), args...); }
inline void inc(int &x, int y=1) { x += y; if(x >= M) x -= M; }
inline void dec(int &x, int y=1) { x -= y; if(x < 0) x += M; }
inline int power(int x, int y) {
  int res = 1;
  for(; y; y>>=1, x = mul(x, x)) if(y & 1) res = mul(res, x);
  return res;
}
inline int inv(int x) { return power(x, M - 2); }

const int N = 250005, K = 19;
int n, k;

int fac[N], ifac[N];
void prefac(int n) {
  fac[0] = 1;
  for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) fac[i] = mul(fac[i - 1], i);
  ifac[n] = inv(fac[n]);
  for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; --i) ifac[i] = mul(ifac[i + 1], i + 1);

    return 0;

  for (int c = 0; c < K; ++c) f[0][c] = 1;
  if (k < K) for (int s = 1; s <= n; ++s) f[s][k] = 0;
  for (int s = 1; s <= n; ++s) {

      int res = 0;
      for (int t = s; t; t = (t-1) & s) {

        res = add(res, mul(ifac[t], k - c, f[s ^ t][c + 1]));

      f[s][c] = res;

}

#include <iostream>

#include <functional>
using namespace std;
using ll = long long;

int M;
inline int add(int x, int y) { int z = x + y; return z >= M ? z - M : z; }
inline int sub(int x, int y) { return x - y < 0 ? x - y + M : x - y; }
inline int mul(int x, int y) { return (1LL * x * y) % M; }
inline int power(int x, int y) {
  int res = 1;
  for (; y; y >>= 1, x = mul(x, x)) if (y & 1) res = mul(res, x);
  return res;
}
inline int inv(int x) { return power(x, M - 2); }

const int N = 250005, K = 19;
int n, k;
int fac[N], ifac[N];
void prefac(int n) {
  fac[0] = 1;
  for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) fac[i] = mul(fac[i - 1], i);
  ifac[n] = inv(fac[n]);
  for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; --i) ifac[i] = mul(ifac[i + 1], i + 1);
}

int main() {
  ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
  cin.tie(nullptr);
  cin >> n >> k >> M;
  prefac(n);
  if (n & 1) {
    cout << power(k, n) << '\n';
    return 0;
  }
  vector<vector<int>> memo(n + 1, vector<int>(K, -1));
  function<int(int,int)> dp = [&](int s, int c) -> int {
    if (s == 0) return 1;
    if (c == k) return 0;
    int &res = memo[s][c];
    if (res != -1) return res;
    res = 0;
    int hb = 1;
    while (hb <= s) hb <<= 1;
    hb >>= 1;
    // iterate submasks containing hb
    for (int t = s; t > 0; t = (t - 1) & s) {
      if (!(t & hb)) break; // since we iterate descending, once hb missing, stop
      res = add(res, mul(ifac[t], k - c, dp(s ^ t, c + 1)));
    }
    return res;
  };
  cout << sub(power(k, n), mul(fac[n], dp(n, 0))) << '\n';
  return 0;
}

#include <cstdio>

using namespace std;
using ll = long long;

int MOD;
inline int add_mod(int a, int b) { return a + b >= MOD ? a + b - MOD : a + b; }
inline int sub_mod(int a, int b) { return a - b < 0 ? a - b + MOD : a - b; }
inline int mul_mod(int a, int b) { return (long long)a * b % MOD; }
inline int pow_mod(int a, int e) {
  int r = 1;
  while (e) {
    if (e & 1) r = mul_mod(r, a);
    a = mul_mod(a, a);
    e >>= 1;
  }
  return r;
}
inline int inv_mod(int x) { return pow_mod(x, MOD - 2); }

const int MAXN = 250005, MAXK = 19;
int n, k;
int fact[MAXN], invfact[MAXN];
int memo[MAXN][MAXK];

void pre_fact(int m) {
  fact[0] = 1;
  for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) fact[i] = mul_mod(fact[i-1], i);
  invfact[m] = inv_mod(fact[m]);
  for (int i = m - 1; i >= 0; --i) invfact[i] = mul_mod(invfact[i+1], i+1);
}

int solve(int s, int c) {
  if (s == 0) return 1;
  if (c == k) return 0;
  int &ret = memo[s][c];
  if (ret != -1) return ret;
  ret = 0;
  int hb = 1 << (31 - __builtin_clz(s)); // highest power of two <= s
  for (int t = s; t; t = (t - 1) & s) {
    if (!(t & hb)) break;
    ret = add_mod(ret, mul_mod(invfact[t], k - c, solve(s ^ t, c + 1)));
  }
  return ret;
}

int main() {
  scanf("%d%d%d", &n, &k, &MOD);
  memset(memo, -1, sizeof(memo));
  pre_fact(n);
  if (n & 1) {
    printf("%d\n", pow_mod(k, n));
    return 0;
  }
  printf("%d\n", sub_mod(pow_mod(k, n), mul_mod(fact[n], solve(n, 0))));
  return 0;
}

#include <cstdio>
#include <cctype>
#include <vector>
#include <cstring>
using namespace std;
using ll = long long;

int M;
inline int plus_mod(int a, int b) { return a + b >= M ? a + b - M : a + b; }
inline int minus_mod(int a, int b) { return a - b < 0 ? a - b + M : a - b; }
inline int mult_mod(int a, int b) { return (long long)a * b % M; }
inline int pow_mod(int a, int e) {
  int r = 1;
  while (e) { if (e & 1) r = mult_mod(r, a); a = mult_mod(a, a); e >>= 1; }
  return r;
}
inline int inv_mod(int x) { return pow_mod(x, M - 2); }

const int MAXN = 250005, MAXK = 19;
int n, k;
int fact[MAXN], ifact[MAXN];
int memo[MAXN][MAXK];

void precompute_factorials(int limit) {
  fact[0] = 1;
  for (int i = 1; i <= limit; ++i) fact[i] = mult_mod(fact[i-1], i);
  ifact[limit] = inv_mod(fact[limit]);
  for (int i = limit - 1; i >= 0; --i) ifact[i] = mult_mod(ifact[i+1], i+1);
}

int get_highest_bit(int x) {
  int hb = 1;
  while (hb <= x) hb <<= 1;
  return hb >> 1;
}

int dfs(int s, int c) {
  if (s == 0) return 1;
  if (c == k) return 0;
  int &ref = memo[s][c];
  if (ref != -1) return ref;
  ref = 0;
  int hb = get_highest_bit(s);
  // iterate over all submasks that contain hb
  // start from s and go down using (t-1)&s, but stop when t loses hb
  for (int t = s; t > 0; t = (t - 1) & s) {
    if (!(t & hb)) break;
    ref = plus_mod(ref, mult_mod(ifact[t], k - c, dfs(s ^ t, c + 1)));
  }
  return ref;
}

int main() {
  // input using getchar/putchar for speed
  auto read_int = [&]() -> int {
    char ch; int f = 1, x = 0;
    while (isspace(ch = getchar()));
    if (ch == '-') { f = -1; ch = getchar(); }
    do { x = x * 10 + ch - '0'; ch = getchar(); } while (isdigit(ch));
    return x * f;
  };
  auto write_int = [&](int x) {
    if (x == 0) { putchar('0'); return; }
    if (x < 0) { putchar('-'); x = -x; }
    char stk[20]; int top = 0;
    while (x) { stk[top++] = '0' + x % 10; x /= 10; }
    while (top) putchar(stk[--top]);
  };
  n = read_int(); k = read_int(); M = read_int();
  memset(memo, -1, sizeof(memo));
  precompute_factorials(n);
  if (n & 1) {
    write_int(pow_mod(k, n));
    putchar('\n');
    return 0;
  }
  write_int(minus_mod(pow_mod(k, n), mult_mod(fact[n], dfs(n, 0))));
  putchar('\n');
  return 0;
}
